line.comment: * ZH 2.0 - from now on this script only handles the completion of a planetary terraforming project.
* Raw sector stats (manpower, support, research) exclude external modifiers such as perks (Faster Research, Extra Support) or foreign docks.
* update amount of currently ongoing planet projects
* update planet table.
* Update terraforming sector list.
* Remove this sector if it no longer has any active terraforming project.
* Terraforming stat bonuses
* Unique planet bonus gets applied first.
* The generic terraforming bonus is applied afterward.
* Normal planets receive +25%; special planet effects may modify or remove it.
* Raw sector stats.
* Research intentionally excludes Faster Research here.
* Generic terraforming bonus percentage.
* Normal planets: +25%
* Barren Worlds: +35%
* Gaia Worlds: +50%
* Tomb Worlds: +0%
* ===== Unique stat bonuses and exceptions =====
* *** POPULATION CATEGORY ***
* Common: +20 max pops.
* Uncommon: +30 max pops.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: New uncommon effect: +1 max pop for every 5% sector research.
* Uses raw sector research and therefore excludes Faster Research.
* *** SUPPORT CATEGORY ***
* Common: +2 station support. Repair+ also grants +2 station support.
* Uncommon: +4 station support.
* *** RESEARCH CATEGORY ***
* Common: +30% research rate.
* Uncommon: +60% research rate.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: New uncommon effect: +1 research rate for every 5 max pops.
* *** GENERIC BONUS EXCEPTIONS ***
* Rare effect: Gaia Worlds give a +50% base generic bonus, adjusted by galaxy modifier later.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: New rare effect: Tomb Worlds provide salvage instead of the generic terraforming bonus.
* Anomalous effect: Barren Worlds give a +35% base generic bonus, adjusted by galaxy modifier later.
* ===== Generic terraforming bonus =====
* ZH 2.0: Normal terraformed planets improve all sector stats by 25%.
* Special planet effects may override the generic bonus percentage.
* Expanded 2.2: Extra Stats Mode reduces positive generic terraforming bonuses by 5 percentage points.
* Expanded 2.2: Preserve fractional bonuses across terraforming projects.
* Store remainders independently for manpower, support, and research.
* Remainders are represented in hundredths of a stat point.
* ===== Commit sector stats =====
* Mordan9
* Keep local Outpost restriction synchronized with sector manpower.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: Tomb Worlds do not improve sector stats.

* Add-Ons 1.2: Terraforming 25 (1.6: changed to 18) planets will give you the hidden terraforming mastery perk, applied throughout your empire (see ZH.Terraforming.Get.Limit and ZH.Terraforming.Get.Penalty.Global)
* Mastery improves your global limit. It reduces the number of planets by 1. For example, if it took 4 planets to support 1 additional project across your empire, it will now take 3 planets.
* Add-Ons 2.1: Kha'ak Hive Quest - quest progresses from 'found' to 'terraformed'
* Again, the stages are:
* - NULL (not yet started)
* - Found (ship recycled; player's curiosity leads to the hive sector. See Mayhem.Recycle)
* - Terraformed (hive planet terraformed; a large Kha'ak raid will spawn)
* - Completed (raid defeated; player has completed the quest)
* - Failed (raid killed player's Outpost)
* Terraforming completed quest message.
